scope: Read-only source, existing tests/contracts and retained development-seed diagnostic review. No simulation, Cargo, test execution, new research, reserved cohort, source edit or task-status change.
conclusion: No justified mechanism correction identified; an explicit game-design decision and causal specification are required.
geography_scope: One retained development seed, 252 months; country-month exposures are not independent trials or evidence that a new mechanism would satisfy A1.

contract_resolution.authorization: Smallest justified political correction may change gameplay, but aggregate failure alone does not supply a causal model.
contract_resolution.resources_vs_obedience: Separate inputs/effects do not imply mathematically independent non-compensable loyalty ceilings. Existing documented formula is additive and caps useful provisioning; tests require both reachable paid recovery and political loss that remains unreachable even at saturation.
contract_resolution.new_party_grace: El Salvador changed accountable party; observed renewed grace follows an explicit contract, unlike an already-repaired same-party snap-election reset.
contract_resolution.macro_crisis_gate: Current electoral coup route explicitly requires live discontent >= .25. Original design notes acknowledge paid-army/non-street cases it does not represent; no unique new trigger is defined by that admission.

single_unresolved_design_question: Should a specifically modeled conflict between the civilian executive and an institution with removal leverage independently threaten obedience when provisioning is adequate and macro discontent is below .25? This is not a recommendation to add such a route: the current observation has no independent dispute signal with which to justify or calibrate it.
rejected_directions: Do not repeat removal of civilian confidence from the AI inverse: retained trial worsened median top-three share from displayed .59 to .67.
Do not repeat stronger confidence coefficient search: retained trials include Algeria chronology/A2 regressions and A1 failure.
Do not relabel a new political loyalty ceiling or deletion of the live discontent guard as an arithmetic correction.
Do not add nation quotas, historical-calendar forced coups, selected seeds or weaker A1 thresholds.
possible_future_contract_requirements: An observable causal trigger separate from merely high removal leverage or historical coup identity.
A player-visible prevention/response that does not erase already-paid equipment resources or bypass fiscal/command authority.
Explicit negative controls for quiet funded countries, no-Army/strong civilian-control states, ordinary new-party grace, and already-resolved crises.
Preserve the existing separately timed programme-veto/Algeria path or explicitly justify and review a changed interaction before measuring A1.
Predeclare the expected behavior and regressions before running unchanged A1-A10; no claim that this will improve aggregate spread.
